span.p:
1. Define criteria
per theme
(not generic quality)

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
2. Build gold set
300-500 complaints
2+ expert annotators

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
3. Implement unit evals
Exact match, set coverage
taxonomy compliance, format

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
4. Design LLM judge
Binary YES/NO criteria
Chain-of-thought + examples

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
5. Validate judge
vs gold set
Kappa > 0.6 per criterion

6. Error analysis
Cluster failures
Prioritise by impact

7. CI/CD integration
Run on every
prompt change

8. Online eval sampling
1-2% production traffic
Alert on drift
